description: Patient occupied a Deluxe Room billed at INR 10000 per day for 2 days (exceeding INR 5000 cap). Total claim includes excess room rent of INR 10000, plus professional fees of INR 20000 and OT charges of INR 15000 subject to proportional deduction ratio (5000/10000 = 0.50), yielding a total deterministic deduction of INR 27500.

source.quote: Deluxe Room Charges: 2 days @ INR 10000.00/day = Total INR 20000.00.
Professional Fees: Surgeon Fee INR 12000.00, Anesthetist Fee INR 5000.00, Consultation Charges INR 3000.00. Subtotal: INR 20000.00.

calculation_steps: Step 1 (Excess Room Rent): Daily room rent billed = INR 10000.00. Policy room rent cap = INR 5000.00. Daily excess = INR 10000.00 - INR 5000.00 = INR 5000.00. For 2 days of hospitalization, excess room rent deduction = 2 days * INR 5000.00/day = INR 10000.00 (non-payable).
Step 2 (Proportional Ratio Calculation): Actual daily room rent (INR 10000.00) exceeds cap (INR 5000.00). Proportional payable ratio = 5000 / actual_daily_rate = 5000 / 10000 = 0.50 (50.0%).

Step 3 (Professional Fees Proportional Deduction): Total professional fees billed = INR 20000.00. Payable portion = INR 20000.00 * 0.50 = INR 10000.00. Disallowed deduction = INR 20000.00 - INR 10000.00 = INR 10000.00.

Step 4 (OT Charges Proportional Deduction): Total operation theatre charges billed = INR 15000.00. Payable portion = INR 15000.00 * 0.50 = INR 7500.00. Disallowed deduction = INR 15000.00 - INR 7500.00 = INR 7500.00.
Step 5 (Total Combined Deduction): Sum of disallowances = Excess Room Rent (INR 10000.00) + Professional Fees Deduction (INR 10000.00) + OT Charges Deduction (INR 7500.00) = INR 27500.00.
expected_findings.explanation: Actual daily room rent of INR 10000 exceeds the policy cap of INR 5000 per day. Excess room rent of INR 10000 is disallowed, and associated professional fees (INR 20000) and OT charges (INR 15000) are reduced by 50% under the 5000 / actual daily rate proportional deduction formula, resulting in a total deterministic deduction of INR 27500.

source.quote: Section 2.2 (Room Rent Daily Limit and Proportional Deduction): The maximum eligible room and boarding expense covered by the insurer is INR 5000 per day of hospitalization. Any room rent charges incurred in excess of INR 5000 per day are non-payable by the insurer and shall be borne entirely by the insured person. If the actual daily room rent exceeds INR 5000, then professional fees and operation theatre charges are payable only in the ratio 5000 / actual daily rate, with the remaining balance of such charges being non-payable.
